title: slugify strict mode leaves the replacement character at the ends
prompt: In slugify.js, with the strict option, input that begins or ends with characters that strict mode strips still produces a slug with a leading or trailing replacement character. For example slugify('! Come on, fhqwhgads !', { strict: true }) returns '-Come-on-fhqwhgads-' but should return 'Come-on-fhqwhgads'. Please fix strict mode so the result has no leading or trailing replacement character and repeated ones are still collapsed, without changing non-strict output.
